name: ShinyBorderButton
description: Dark surface button whose 1.5px border carries a rotating conic light beam, with configurable beam color and orbit duration, implemented with pure CSS.
a11yNotes: Semantic <button type="button"> with a visible :focus-visible outline and native disabled support (beam pauses when disabled). The beam layer is aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the beam stops rotating and becomes a static gradient border.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Button label (ignored when children are provided).

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Seconds for the beam to travel once around the border.

propsApi.name: disabled
propsApi.description: Disable the button and pause the beam.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
